purpose: Training-only characterisation before an additional untouched-cohort evaluation; no external-label based preset selection
data_license: Upstream CC BY-SA 4.0; fetched SDFs not redistributed
candidate_rationale: A fixed finer grid samples the Gaussian more densely; training-only field-block scaling makes differing numerical field units explicit. Candidate chosen on numerical-method grounds before this sensitivity run, not as the winner on inspected external R2. The older raw-grid outcomes are retained; no app default is silently changed.
variants: Fixed baseline, MMFF94, four half-step grid phases, three independent 0.25-A/5-degree relative rigid-pose perturbations and a common integer-A translation control; first fitting reference fixed for relative perturbations
interpretation: Thresholds are predeclared engineering flags, not universal pharmacological validation cutoffs. Charge and relative-pose sensitivity can be genuine method/data dependence, not code errors. No generated conformer or experimental binding mode is validated by rigid perturbations.
next_evaluation_rule: Freeze candidate_block_1A unchanged after numerical controls and all sampling-phase flags pass on the three training sets. If they fail, do not consume fresh external labels to choose a replacement. Independent charge/pose flags remain model-specific warnings. CoMFA remains experimental. Fresh public historical cohorts are not blinded prospective evidence.
